cd /workspace
python3 - <<'PY'
import csv,collections,re
with open('input.csv','rb') as f:
    data=f.read()
print('CRLF',data.count(b'\r\n'),'LF',data.count(b'\n'),'tabs',data.count(b'\t'))
# read lines
lines=data.split(b'\n')
if lines[-1]==b'': lines=lines[:-1]
print('nlines',len(lines))
for l in lines[:10]: print(repr(l))
# field separators
print('commas per line', collections.Counter(l.count(b',') for l in lines).most_common(10))
# check quote
print('quotes',data.count(b'"'),data.count(b"'"))
# split on comma first line
for i in range(5):
    print(lines[i].split(b','), [repr(x) for x in lines[i].split(b',')])
# whitespace stats inside fields
ws=collections.Counter()
nonascii=0
for l in lines[:100000]:
    if any(c>127 for c in l): nonascii+=1
    for x in l.split(b','):
        ws[(x[:1],x[-1:])]+=1
print('nonascii sample',nonascii)
print('boundary sample',ws.most_common(20))
PY

cd /workspace
python3 - <<'PY'
import collections
with open('input.csv','rb') as f: inp=f.read().split(b'\n')
with open('expected.csv','rb') as f: exp=f.read().split(b'\n')
if inp[-1]==b'': inp=inp[:-1]
if exp[-1]==b'': exp=exp[:-1]
print(len(inp),len(exp))
bad=0
for i,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(inp,exp)):
    parts=a.split(b',')
    t=b';'.join(x.strip().upper() for x in parts[::-1])+b';OK'
    if t!=b:
        bad+=1
        if bad<10: print(i,repr(a),repr(b),repr(t))
print('bad',bad)
# whitespace length distributions / expected field vocabulary
inlen=collections.Counter()
for a in inp:
    for x in a.split(b','):
        inlen[len(x)-len(x.strip())]+=1
print('padding total per field',inlen)
# Check expected ends
print(repr(exp[-1]),repr(inp[-1]))
PY
